subject: Follow-up: Skyline incident war-room no-show — new bridge & action owners
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@skylineapps.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduled incident war-room — Skyline payment latency (9:30 AM PDT)

Hi Alex —

I joined the scheduled war-room at 9:30 AM PDT but it looks like Skyline wasn’t on the bridge. I waited ~10 minutes and then dropped the call to free up capacity for other customers.

We need to get this back on track quickly — please advise what happened on your side (paging, on-call, tooling) and whether you can rejoin. I’ve attached our escalation playbook for reference.

Proposed immediate options:
- If you can rejoin within the next 60 minutes, we’ll open a new bridge and do a short triage.
- If not, propose two candidate windows this afternoon and we’ll lock one down and collect logs ahead of time.

Attachments: Escalation-Playbook.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduled incident war-room — Skyline payment latency (9:30 AM PDT)

On it — I was on standby. Do you want me to open a new bridge now or wait for Alex's reply? I can also loop in SRE if we need deeper debugging.

- Sean

On Thu, May 28, 2026 at 09:15 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex -
> 
> I joined the scheduled war-room at 9:30 AM PDT but it looks like Skyline wasn’t on the bridge...
From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@skylineapps.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Skyline Apps SRE <oncall@skylineapps.com>, Jordan Reese <jordan.reese@skylineapps.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduled incident war-room — Skyline payment latency (9:30 AM PDT)

Hi Olga —

Super sorry about that — we had an internal paging/rotation bug this morning and the on-call didn’t get the escalation. We just found the missed page and are spinning up people now. That was entirely on our side.

We can do either 12:30 PM PDT or 1:30 PM PDT today for a short war-room. If 12:30 works for you and your ops folks, please share a bridge link and any logs templates we should pre-fill.

Apologies again for the no-show. We appreciate you holding a slot.

— Alex
Alex Harper
Head of Platform Reliability, Skyline Apps
alex.harper@skylineapps.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@skylineapps.com>, Skyline Apps SRE <oncall@skylineapps.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduled incident war-room — Skyline payment latency (9:30 AM PDT)

Thanks Alex — 12:30 PM PDT works for us. New bridge details below. Please have an SRE or engineer ready to share the following during triage:
- Recent service logs around the latency spike (use the attached requested-logs-template.txt)
- Any recent deploys or config changes in the last 24 hours
- Error rates and banking gateway correlation (if available)

New bridge (12:30 PM PDT): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Passcode: R3dwood
Bridge owner: Sean Gallagher (I’ll hand the first 15 minutes to your SRE to confirm context).

Action owners:
- Log collection: Dev Patel (will provide upload link)
- Initial triage & customer context: Alex/Oncall
- Escalation coordination / follow-ups: Olga Petrov

Attachments: requested-logs-template.txt (TXT)

See you at 12:30. If anything changes before then, reply-all.

Olga
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Harper <alex.harper@skylineapps.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduled incident war-room — Skyline payment latency (9:30 AM PDT)

I’ll own the log collection and drop the archive in the shared folder before we start. Upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-incident-logs

Steps I’ll take before 12:30:
1) Pull nginx and payments-service logs for last 60 minutes and the 5-minute spike window.
2) Sanitize any PII per our runbook and upload as two files: payments-logs-20260528.tar.gz and nginx-access-sample-20260528.txt.
3) Post a short summary in the folder and ping Alex’s on-call for confirmation.

If Skyline wants me to collect any additional traces or perf flamegraphs, tell me now and I’ll include them.

— Dev
From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@skylineapps.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduled incident war-room — Skyline payment latency (9:30 AM PDT)

Thanks everyone — we were able to join and the triage helped isolate the gateway timeout. Dev, I see the uploads — thanks for the quick turnaround.

I’ll follow up after we have a postmortem with a timeline and any service changes we make. Appreciate the fast response and the new bridge details.

— Alex
